# noderings_group (Resource)

A group of users and service accounts. Manage its members with `noderings_group_membership` and its role with `noderings_role_assignment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "noderings_group" "ops" {
  name        = "ops"
  description = "Operations team"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, 3 to 255 characters, unique in the organization (case-insensitive).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. The API cannot clear a description, so removing this argument keeps the current one.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Group ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import a group by its ID.
terraform import noderings_group.ops 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
